# Assets · Symbols

5 files under `assets/Symbols/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for phlo-talk.svg>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

Product symbols built from the split-bubble grammar: Talk, Partner, Scribe, Settle, Publish. Drawn in Paper-theme colors. For Sumi, swap ink for #f2f1ec and vermilion for #ff5b3d.
